# @game-studio/generic-reels

Package used for the reels of a spin game

## Usage

### Step 1: Create a service
To begin you will need to create a generic service using the GRService class.

A basic usable example of this would be:
```ts
export const myGameGRService = new GRService();
```

However the prefered way is to create an extended class , as this give you a cleaner way to store and set new settings:
```ts
class MyFirstGRService extends GRService {
    constructor() {
         this.coreSettings = {} //optional
         this.reelSettings = {} //optional
    }
}
export const myGameGRService = new MyFirstGRService();
```

### Step 2: Create Reels

Typically reels would be generated by a for loop to build each reel.

Here is an example across two classes:


ReelView.ts
```ts
export class ReelView extends GRReelView<SymbolView> {
    constructor(reelSize: number, reelIndex: number) {
         super(SymbolView, myGameGRService, reelSize, reelIndex);
    }
}
```

SlotView.ts
```ts
export class SlotlView extends Container {

    // holds reference to each reel.
    private _myReels: ReelView[] = [];

    constructor() {
        super();
        this.buildReels(); 
    }

    private buildReels(): void {

        // each number in the array represents a new reel and it's size.
        const reelSizes: number[] = [3, 3, 3, 3, 3];
        const numberOfReels: number = reelSizes.length;

        for(let $reelIndex = 0; $reelIndex < numberOfReels; $reelIndex++) {
            const reel: ReelView = new ReelView(reelSizes[$reelIndex], $reelIndex);
            this.addChild(reel);
            this._myReels.push(reel);
        }
    }
}
```
---

## Changes :

- **self updating** `No more calling update for each reel!`

- **modular setup** `GRService is no longer a singleton, this allows for multiple reels to be setup`

- **one place for settings**  `All settings are now accessable and defined from the initialised GRService` 

- **eventFire system** `The package no longer uses overrideable callbacks but now uses the new eventFire system where events can be easily navigated and set. All core classes (GRService, GRReelView, GRSymbol) have an eventFire interface`

- **plugins**  `Cascade functionality has been recreated as an extention that extends core classes. You must use GC prefixed classes for access to these extended methods`

## Notable changes:

- `Model data such as onScreenReels ect is no longer directly acessible from GRService class and is now found at [YOUR GRService].model`

- `Effects are now found within the new eventFire system`

## New Features:

- **snapshot** `With snapshot enabled, you are free to manipulate the visble reels and not worry about symbols flicking back to their previous state when the next spin sequence is called!`

- **recursiveUpdates** `Enabling recursiveUpdates will update the transform of all children of your GR or GC symbols when skins are being set (prevents unpredictable behaviour when setting visibilty on display objects)`

- **displayreels**  `displayreels array can be found on the service model, it can be used to set what the visible symbols should be. useful for resuming or returning from a bonus state where the the reel state is not saved or not possible`

## API Reference

### GRSymbol
 
#### setStaticSkin()  `override`

is called when the parent reels, currentMapIndex changes because of reel movement.

```ts
setStaticSkin();
```

---
#### setAnimationSkin() `override`

is called when the parent reel has stopped

```ts
setAnimationSkin();
```
---

#### dynamicBlurTexture(`defaultState, blurState, speedTrigger`): Texture

determines if the texture should show as default or blurred dependning on the speed of the parent reel.

```ts
dynamicBlurTexture(defaultState: Texture, blurState: Texture, speedTrigger: number): Texture;
```

| Parameter | Type     | Description                       |
| :-------- | :------- | :-------------------------------- |
| `defaultState`      | `Texture` | **Required**. The default static texture that will show when not bluring. |
| `blurState`      | `Texture` | **Required**. The blur texture that will show when speed exceeds specified trigger. |
| `speedTrigger`      | `number` | **Required**. The speed threshhold before using the blur state. |


---

#### preDraw() `override`

is called before a draw event

```ts
preDraw();
```
---
#### postDraw() `override`

is called after a draw event

```ts
postDraw();
```
---
---

#### eventFire: `GRSymbolEvent` 
access to all events emitted from symbol.

---
#### symbolData: `ISymbolData` 
returns data of the symbol.

---
#### parentReelData: `IParentReelData` 
returns data of the reel the symbol belongs to.

---
---
---

### GRReelView
#### GRReelView(`SymbolType, service, reelSize, reelIndex`) : void

| Parameter | Type     | Description                       |
| :-------- | :------- | :-------------------------------- |
| `SymbolType`      | `GenericSymbol` | **Required**. expects your symbol type, it is recommended to create your own class that extends GRSymbol to pass here. |
| `service`      | `GRService` | **Required**.  The allocated service made for this set of reels, reel settings will be defined by this service. |
| `reelSize`      | `number` | **Required**.  A number to represent how many symbols you would like to be visible in that reel. |
| `reelIndex`      | `number` | **Required**.  A number to represent the reels index, this is typically the for loop increment number. |

---
#### getGridAtVisible( `grid`): GenericSymbol 

returns a symbol from the visible symbols on reel. 

 getting grid 0 will return the first visible symbol of the reel.

```ts
getGridAtVisible(grid: number): GenericSymbol;
```
| Parameter | Type     | Description                       |
| :-------- | :------- | :-------------------------------- |
| `grid`      | `number` | **Required**. index coordinate of the on screen symbol you wish to return.  |

---
#### preDraw() `override`

is called before a draw event

```ts
preDraw();
```

---
#### postDraw() `override`

is called after a draw event

```ts
postDraw();
```
---
#### enableMask() 

mask will be based on frameTransformation or on a provided texture size if specified in settings.

see coreSettings for more on how to create a custom mask .

```ts
enableMask();
```
---
#### disableMask() 

mask will be based on frameTransformation or on a provided texture size if specified in settings.

see coreSettings for more on how to create a custom mask .

```ts
disableMask();
```
---
---
#### eventFire: `GRReelEvent` 
access to all events that are emitted from the reel.

---
#### reelIndex: `number` 
returns the reel index id.

---
#### speed: `number` 
returns the reel speed.

---
#### reelSize: `number` 
returns the count of onscreen symbols of the reel.

---
#### reelBounds: `Rectangle` 
returns the bounds of the reel.

---
#### isSpinning: `boolean` 
returns if the reel is moving or not.

---
#### symbols: `GenericSymbol[]` 
returns all symbols of the reel. ( onscreen and offscreen )

---
#### symbolHeight: `number` 
returns the height of each symbol after formatting

---
---
---

### GRService

#### runSpinSequence() 

this will begin the spin sequence

```ts
runSpinSequence();
```
---

---
#### eventFire: `GRServiceEvent` 
access to all events that are emitted in this class and the model

---
#### model: `GRModel` 
gets the model that belongs to the service.

---
#### coreSettings: `ICoreSettings` 
returns or sets  if spin is complete.

---
#### symbolSettings: `ISymbolSettings` 
 returns or sets the currect spin sequence actions.

---
#### reelSettings: `IReelSettings` 
 returns or sets all registered reel start indexes.

---
---
---
### GRModel
#### spinComplete: `boolean` 
`bindable` returns or sets  if spin is complete.

---
#### selectedSpinSequence: `SpinProfileSequence` 
`bindable` returns or sets the currect spin sequence actions.

---
#### startPosition: `number[]` 
`bindable` eturns or sets all registered reel start indexes.

---
#### targetPosition: `number[]` 
`bindable` returns or sets all registered reel stop indexes.

---
#### displayReels: `number[][]` 
`bindable`  sets all current visible symbols.

---
#### onScreenReels: `number[][]` 
`bindable` returns or sets the current reel map being used.

---
#### spinSpeedValues: `number[]` 
`bindable` returns or sets the array of spinSpeeds to be used.

---
#### spinState: `number[]`
`bindable` 
returns or sets the array of spinStates

## Development

### Testing

```
npm run test
```
```
npm run test:continuous
```

Testing is ran using Karma and will execute all `**/*.spec.ts` files within the `tests` folder.

The `:continuous` flag is useful while developing because it will watch for changes in the source code and tests and execute the suite accordingly.

#### Coverage

Test coverage is generated and available under `reports/coverage` once a test run has completed.

### Linting

```
npm run lint
```

Runs `eslint` and outputs any errors.

### Building and Documentation

```
npm run build
```

This will clean the distribution folder, build the project and generate the documentation.

### Publishing

This package should not be published manually. Publishing is handled by the parent [game-studio](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio) using lerna.

**Note:** it's worth noting that the private registry the package is published to is defined in the `package.json` file.

### TypeScript

#### tsconfig.json

This package is built in TypeScript and the options are controlled by `tsconfig.json` for use in the IDE.
